Container.Name: Trekker
Container.Overview:
A TV show and movie tracker: log the episodes and films you have watched, keep a watchlist, rate and review, discover what is popular, and see exactly how many hours you have spent watching.
Data lives in one SQLite file under the mounted data path. Back that up and you have backed up everything.
Requires a free TMDB API key. Optional integrations: Plex (sign-in, history sync, webhook), Trakt import, OMDb scores, and web push notifications.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds trekker.db, the whole database. MUST be owned by uid 1000 — run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/trekker && chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/trekker

Config.Name: AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Signs session cookies. A long random string — generate with: openssl rand -base64 48. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Free key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api — either a v3 API key or a v4 read access token.

Config.Name: WATCH_REGION
Config.Description: ISO 3166-1 country code deciding whose streaming availability shows under 'Where to watch'.

Config.Name: CRON_SECRET
Config.Description: Guards the two daily jobs (/api/notifications/run and /api/lists/refresh). Needed if you set up the User Scripts entry; without it those endpoints return 503. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: OMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Free key from https://www.omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx — adds Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and IMDb scores to title pages.

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Enables push notifications. Generate the pair with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys. Push only works over HTTPS, so this needs the reverse proxy in front.

Config.Name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. The private half of the VAPID pair above.

Config.Name: VAPID_SUBJECT
Config.Description: Optional. Contact URL the push services see, e.g. mailto:you@example.com

Config.Name: PLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional, Plex Pass only. Logs a play the moment Plex scrobbles it. Point Plex at https://your-trekker/api/plex/webhook?key=<this>. URL-safe characters only — generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_'

Config.Name: PLEX_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Identifies this install to plex.tv for 'Continue with Plex'. Derived from AUTH_SECRET when unset, which is fine for a single deployment.

Config.Name: TRAKT_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional fallback. Trakt is configured per user under Settings -> Trakt; setting this means users enter only their username. Create an app at https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications.
